rows.grounds: with-six+long (ṣaḍdīrgheṇa), inst.sg of bahuvrīhi/tatpuruṣa compound ṣaṣ+dīrgha qualifying sakāreṇa
with-letter-sa (sakāreṇa), inst.sg of sakāra 'the letter sa'
with-haṃ+preceded (haṃpūrveṇa), inst.sg of compound haṃ+pūrva 'preceded by haṃ', qualifying sakāreṇa
six+limb (ṣaḍaṅgakam), nom.sg of compound ṣaṣ+aṅgaka 'having six limbs/parts'; acc.sg also possible (AMBIGUOUS)
